road.title: Where you are from
road.description: A broad figure built like a cupboard in a uniform that belongs to a different job, next to a small bell marked RING FOR ATTENTION and a larger one marked DO NOT. Cuthbert is a Homesick Milestone and a stone that insists it is from a much better road than this one.

character.name: Cuthbert Marrow
character.description: A broad figure built like a cupboard in a uniform that belongs to a different job, next to a small bell marked RING FOR ATTENTION and a larger one marked DO NOT. Cuthbert is a Homesick Milestone and a stone that insists it is from a much better road than this one.

npc.narrative: In the pomeriggio the tempesta does its worst, and the pioggia hits the strada like a creditor. You find Cuthbert Marrow, a milestone, standing in a coda of one beside the road. A fulmine lights him up, and he does not give up his place.
npc.native: Buon pomeriggio! Sono di una strada migliore, e vengo da lontano. E tu, di dove sei?
npc.translation: Good afternoon! I am from a better road, and I come from far away. And you, where are you from?

correction.translation: Good morning! I am from England.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely start! You greeted Cuthbert and told him where you are from in Italian, and he understood you.

objectiveResults.feedback: Yes, you told Cuthbert where you are from with "Sono di"; with a country, Italian says "Sono dell'Inghilterra".
Not yet: Cuthbert would like you to say where you live. He will ask again later.
Not yet: you can tell Cuthbert that you speak a little of his language. He will ask again later.

correction.translation: Good morning! I am from England.

openObjectives.prompt: Tell Cuthbert where you live, using Italian.
Cuthbert has noticed your accent and is being polite about it, with visible effort. Tell Cuthbert that you speak a little of their language, using Italian.

npc.narrative: The pioggia hits the strada, and a grande fulmine lights up the pietra dietro you. Cuthbert Marrow stands molto dritto, with a pause left beside him for a successor who has not come. He is wet, but describes it as temporary.
npc.native: Ah, Inghilterra! Io abito qui, sulla strada. Tu dove vivi?
npc.translation: Ah, England! I live here, on the road. Where do you live?

player: Abito a Londra. Tu... abiti sulla strada? Bene.

verdict.overallFeedback: Lovely, you answered where you live and even asked Cuthbert a question back in good Italian. Keep chatting and a chance to talk about languages will come up.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you told Cuthbert where you live with "Abito a Londra."
You haven't said yet that you speak a little of Cuthbert's language; Cuthbert will ask about it again later.

openObjectives.prompt: Cuthbert has noticed your accent and is being polite about it, with visible effort. Tell Cuthbert that you speak a little of their language, using Italian.

npc.narrative: La pioggia hammers the strada, and a lampo shows Cuthbert Marrow standing very dritto on his verge. Beside him he leaves a small pausa, for the successor, who is late. You wait in the fila behind nobody.
npc.native: Sì, io abito sulla strada. Io parlo italiano, sempre. Tu parli italiano?
npc.translation: Yes, I live on the road. I speak Italian, always. Do you speak Italian?

verdict.overallFeedback: Nice job answering Cuthbert's question in Italian and saying you speak a little. Just add \"di\" after \"un po'\" next time.

objectiveResults.feedback: Well done, you used "Parlo" correctly to say you speak a little Italian; just remember the little word "di" in "un po' di italiano".

npc.narrative: The pioggia hammers the strada, and a fulmine lights the sky from end to end. Cuthbert Marrow, a pietra of very good family, does not blink. He leans toward you as if you were first in the fila, and leaves a small pause behind you for someone who has not arrived.
npc.native: Bravo, un po' è molto! Qui tutti parlano italiano. E a Londra, parli italiano?
npc.translation: Well done, a little is a lot! Everyone here speaks Italian. And in London, do you speak Italian?

player: No, a Londra parlo inglese. Tu sei di... quale strada?

npc.narrative: La pioggia batte sulla strada, and a lampo shows every chip in Cuthbert's face. He leaves a pausa beside him for the successor, who is, as usual, in ritardo. Behind you he has formed a coda of one, per principio.
npc.native: Io sono di una strada migliore, lontano da qui. Qui piove forte. A Londra piove?
npc.translation: I am from a better road, far from here. Here it rains hard. Does it rain in London?

player: Si! A Londra piove sempre. Ciao Cuthbert!

npc.narrative: Un fulmine splits the cielo above la strada, and Cuthbert Marrow does not blink, having no eyelids and molto dignity. He leaves a pausa beside him, exactly the width of a successor. La pioggia forms a line on the pietra and waits its turn.
npc.native: Sempre! Allora Londra è come qui. Io abito sulla strada, con la pioggia. Tu abiti in una casa?
npc.translation: Always! Then London is like here. I live on the road, with the rain. Do you live in a house?
